'You shall not pass,' he snaps at a wet duck on the doorstep, then settles, cranky as ever, on the steps of his **palace** with his pipe.

{Homer} wakes in {Front} of the {Hut} with a dry *mouth* and a *question mark* floating over his bald head: what can he **drink**? His dim scheme is to lie under the garden hose and open wide, and it blasts him clean across the lawn. 'D'oh!' Finally he dunks a doughnut in a puddle and sips a **drink** of that. 'Mmm.'

{James Bond} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} and, smooth as ever, asks a *standing person* if he might **borrow** a strip of *sun-dried meat*. It is for a gadget from Q that does one absurd thing: it turns jerky into a tiny parachute. Floating out of the window, he calls back, unruffled, 'I only **borrow**; Q will return it, in small pieces.'

{James Bond} kneels in {Front} of the {Dunes}, tuxedo spotless, as a *lord* in a long wig announces that the **monarch** is arriving. Q's umbrella does one absurd thing: it springs open into a throne, just in time. 'Bond. James Bond,' he says, unruffled, and the **monarch** sits down, hands him a secret mission and asks for a small drink, shaken.

{James Bond} strolls through the {Bathroom} of the {Inn}, swings open the mirror and finds behind it a *forbidden grove*. Signs spring up at every tree to **forbid** him: no walking, no tuxedos, no one-liners. Q's fountain pen does one absurd thing and rewrites them all to say 'Welcome'. 'They can **forbid** what they like,' he says, unruffled, strolling on.

{Yoshi} sits in {Front} of the {Inn} in the last of the sun, then flicks out his long tongue and swallows a huge passing cloud. He lays it as a grey egg, which cracks, and the whole sky turns **overcast**, plunging the street into *shade*. 'Yoshi?' he asks, a little gloomy, as the day grows more **overcast** with every egg he lays.

{Yoshi} wanders {Inside} the {Mint}, swallows a *yuan coin* and lays it as an egg, which sprouts a shoot. Delighted, he gulps down a whole *fence* and lays it again around the shoot, plank by plank, until a little **garden** stands among the money presses. 'Yoshi!' he cheers, flutter jumping over his **garden**, where the trees are starting to drip small change.

{Mario} crouches {Inside} the {Boathouse} with a *plum* balanced on his red cap and a *small speech bubble* floating by his moustache: his **plan**. Step one, hit block. Step two, stomp things. Step three, 'Wahoo!' He head-butts a block, gets a coin, stomps the plum by mistake, and cheerfully declares that this too was the **plan**.

{Sailor Moon} twirls through a long sparkly transformation in the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon}, and her moon wand zaps the place back to the **Song dynasty**. A curly tiled *roof* flaps down like a hat and a bent *tree* springs up in a bowl among the scholars. She makes a speech about justice, trips on the bowl and cries loudly, and Luna sighs that the **Song dynasty** is unimpressed.

{Batman} crouches in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and hears a cheerful *pioneer* clomping along the *road* with a wagon, wanting a chat with everyone. Batman will do anything to **avoid** small talk: he fires his grappling hook, glides over the showers and vanishes mid-sentence. 'Hello?' calls the pioneer, and Batman, brooding in a locker, continues to **avoid** him.

The {Joker} lurks in {Front} of the {Water Park} with a fake *helping hand* up his sleeve, offering handshakes. Whoever shakes it sees a plastic *talon* spring out and **grab** their hat, towel or ice cream, while he cackles, green hair flying. Then an inflatable flamingo makes a **grab** for him, and he gets squirted by his own flower.

{Robocop} clanks deep {Inside} the {Lagoon}, stiff and dripping, and politely arrests a blade of *grass* for loitering. His visor flashes directive four: seek **glory**. The frogs erupt in applause, and with his steel chest gleaming he stands to attention in pure **glory**, reading the grass its rights in a flat, heroic voice.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Pool} exactly when he means to, for his **aunt** has sent for him. She is a tiny *woman* who wields an *antique* umbrella and demands fireworks. Cranky, he mutters a spell, a rocket goes off and scorches her bonnet, and his **aunt** thwacks the great wizard smartly on his pointy hat.

{Sailor Moon} strikes a pose in {Front} of the {Casino} to begin her speech about justice, when a small boy tugs her skirt: her *grandson*, visiting from the future in a tiny tiara. 'Grandma!' he says, and she cries loudly at the word. Luna explains that a **grandson** is a **grandson**, and he throws the tiara, exactly as clumsily as she does.

{Tarzan} wakes {Inside} the {Tower}, locked up by civilisation and baffled by the door handle. A parrot drops a *cracked shell* on his head, the signal from his friends, and he answers with a jungle yell as monkeys pass a vine through the window. To **escape**, he swings out over the *road*, dodges the buses and **escapes** into the trees, thumping his chest.

{Yoshi} licks his way {Inside} the {Spa} and snatches somebody's false *fang* off the counter with his long tongue. Gulp. He flutter jumps in a panic, lays an egg, and out pops one shining **tooth**, then another, until the hot tub is bobbing with every **tooth** in town, and Yoshi, who has none of his own, beams.

{Sherlock} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} with a *bundle* of wet towels and deduces the thief from one knot. 'Elementary: a left-handed sailor.' To prove it he must **bind** everything the same way, so he ties up socks, mops and Watson, smug as ever. Watson, unable to move, notes that he has also managed to **bind** his pipe to the violin.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, where a *cracked shell* skitters under his *kicking foot* and a kitten springs out of it, hissing. He gives his jungle yell and has to **jump** for the curtain rail; then all the cats **jump** too, followed by the soap. He has a word with them in cat, and they agree to do this every morning.

{Darth Vader} looms in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring}, breathing loudly, and with the Force lifts a *nail* and a single *page* up towards the ceiling. He drives the nail through the very **top** of the page, at the highest spot in the room. Nobody else can reach the **top**, and he booms his disapproval at anyone who tries.

{Yoshi} tiptoes through the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} and spots a green *jade gem* that looks exactly like a snack. Slurp goes the tongue, down goes the **jade**, and he lays an egg of solid **jade**, as green as he is. Alarms ring, and he flutter jumps past the guards, 'Yoshi!', leaving one glowing egg in the sink.

The {Joker} lurks in the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair}, where tourists are panicking over a spider, and he grins and offers to **calm** them down. One by one he drops *gold coins* into the sink, peering at each through a huge *magnifying glass*, until they stop and stare. Everyone is utterly **calm**, and then the last coin squirts them and he runs away cackling.

{Shrek} wants peace and quiet in the {Basement} of the {Ice Rink}, but a leak drips *rain* through the pipes, so he roars at it. The roar freezes it into **snow**, which piles up on his ears while Donkey will not shut up about how pretty it is. Grumpily he drags a huge *comb* through the drifts and shapes an onion out of **snow**.

{Walter White} works in the {Basement} of the {Pool} with his chemistry class, grinding chalk with a *pestle* for an experiment that must finish at exactly **noon**. He grinds, the class watches, the clock ticks, and on the last stroke of twelve every beaker turns gold. Walter lifts his black hat, proud of such precise science, and announces it is **noon**.

{Lara Croft} strings a *silk thread* across the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} and backflips over it, because a tomb raider must **practise**. She tumbles over it a hundred times, ponytail whipping, and then raises it an inch. A boulder of soap rolls past, and she goes on to **practise** along the ceiling until the cashiers start applauding.

{Pikachu} crackles in the {Bathroom} of the {Fort}, where a *white dove* refuses to leave a cubicle and go back to the *road* outside. 'Pika!' A tiny Thunderbolt on the door handle will **force** it; every feather stands on end and it shoots off. Then a trainer arrives with a Poké Ball to **force** Pikachu in as well, sparks and all.

{Yoshi} flutter jumps {Inside} the {Hut}, where his *father* is snoring in a chair. Slurp: he swallows him whole and lays him as a big mottled egg. When it hatches, out climbs an older, creakier dinosaur with a walking stick: **grandpa**. 'Yoshi,' he grumbles, and **grandpa** goes on at length about how the eggs were bigger in his day.

{Pikachu} sits on a *nameboard* in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} and, with a burnt *bamboo* stick and his cheek sparks, scorches a whole **piece of writing** into the pavement. Every word of it is 'Pika'. A passer-by reads the **piece of writing** aloud, weeps at its beauty, and tries to catch the author in a Poké Ball.

{Robocop} clanks stiffly into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, where a slab of *meat* sits on the sink, and his targeting display locks on. 'Directive two,' he reads out, 'unattended **meat** is not permitted in this area.' He cuffs it politely, reads the **meat** its rights and leads it off, while a sausage tries to climb out of the window.

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier into the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}, where a giant parrot with a yellow *beak* is squawking his secret name. He leaps, taps its *mouth* shut with the flat of his rapier and carves a tiny Z on its nose. He laughs with his **mouth** wide open, the parrot's **mouth** pops open too, and he vanishes, still laughing.

{Gandalf} raps his staff in the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} and, when a fussy *official* denies him a permit, mutters a spell over a *side dish* of peas. The peas rise and stack into a whole **building**, with windows, pointy towers and fireworks from the chimney. 'You shall not pass,' he tells the official, and shuts the door of his **building**.

{Batman} glides through the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} on patrol, following a *road* of wet footprints to a *nameboard* on a door. There is no clue, so he goes back for another **round**, and another. For the ninth **time** he sweeps his cape past the same sink, gruffly muttering that one more **round** will crack it.

{Frodo} tiptoes {Inside} the {Mansion}, small and weary, wishing he were just an **ordinary** hobbit. He slips on the Ring and vanishes, and a great *sail* draped over the piano billows as he bumps into it. Taking the Ring off, he sees his own hairy feet, no quest and no dragons, only an **ordinary** Tuesday, and Sam brings him tea.

{Charlie Brown} sighs in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and lays one careful *stone* to begin a **foundation**, with a *double mountain* of rubble waiting behind him. He steps back to admire it and trips over a football that Lucy has left there. The rubble slides, and the **foundation** cracks in a zigzag exactly like his shirt. 'Good grief.'

{Darth Vader} stalks into the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon}, breathing loudly, and his red lightsaber burns a neat **hole** through the sink. Out pour *water drops*, which he catches in a *matching cup* held up by the Force. He booms his disapproval, slices a second **hole** in the cup by accident, and stands there, dripping, deeply disappointed in everyone.

{James Bond} slips into the {Basement} of the {Mint}, tuxedo spotless, and finds a long *scroll* of banknotes unwinding across the floor. Q's cufflink does one absurd thing: it makes everything **roll up**. He presses it, and the notes, the carpets and the guards' trouser legs all **roll up** tight. 'A nice little earner,' he says, unruffled, tucking the lot under one arm.

{Tarzan} swings down to the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, where a *sunrise* is painted on the wall and a great heap of *soil* blocks the way. He gives his jungle yell, calls in the elephants, and they trample the heap until it is perfectly **flat**. The painted sun peeps over it, and Tarzan lies down, baffled by how **flat** civilisation has become.

{Naruto} bursts {Inside} the {Youth Hostel} in his orange jumpsuit, ready to fight an enormous **ox** whose horns are scraping the ceiling. He makes shadow clones by the dozen to shove it, and it will not budge. Then a small *cow* trots in and moos, and the **ox** follows her out, with Naruto riding on its back, still yelling that he never gives up, slurping ramen.

{Naruto} bursts {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, yelling at the top of his lungs that this place will be **peaceful**, whatever it takes. He sends shadow clones to hammer a *nail* through a loose *roof* that keeps banging, and one Rasengan finishes the job with a huge bang. Finally it is **peaceful**, for one second, until all the clones start cheering.

The {Joker} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} and unrolls a sheet of **paper** showing a *family tree* of bees, every one drawn with his huge grin. He dangles it on a *silk thread* past the queen. She lunges, and the **paper** turns out to be a trick card that squirts her with honey, and he cackles all the way up the stairs.

The {Joker} stands in {Front} of the {Pool} with a clipboard, doing a *headcount* and promising a prize to everybody. He grins until **all** of them have lined up, purple suit gleaming. Then he pulls a trick card from his sleeve, and **all** the flowers on **all** the swimming caps squirt at once, while he cackles and runs.

{Shrek} marches Donkey into the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes} to **train** him to shut up. Every time a *small speech bubble* pops from Donkey's mouth, Shrek grabs it, roars and drops it into a little *river* from the burst pipe, where it floats away. By sunset Donkey is **trained** at last, and goes on talking with his ears.

{Sailor Moon} waves her moon wand in {Front} of the {Beehive}, clutching a *grain stalk* that is her secret snack, and bursts into loud tears whenever anyone looks at it. She sticks out an *elbow* to block the bees and delivers a speech about justice: this snack is strictly **private**. Luna, the talking cat, points out that **private** things should not be waved about.

The {Joker} pops up in {Front} of the {Swamp}, where a quiet *farmstead* has grown into a sleepy **village**. Overnight he swaps all the signs, fills the milk churns with squirting flowers and deals trick cards to the chickens. By morning the whole **village** wakes up with green hair and a huge grin, and he cackles from the duck pond.

{Zorro} climbs down a *stepladder* into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *small altar* holds an old black mask that belonged to his **ancestor**. He bows, cape sweeping, and slashes a Z through the candle smoke in salute. On the wall, a dusty painting of his **ancestor** winks, draws a tiny rapier, slashes a Z back and vanishes laughing.

{Sailor Moon} sparkles through her transformation in {Front} of the {Beehive}, ribbons of **silk** pouring from her moon wand. Clumsy as ever, she strides out along a *plank*, which tips and pitches her off. The bees sail by wrapped in **silk**, and she cries loudly, bound up like a parcel, while Luna quietly helps herself to a scarf.

{Frodo} limps in {Front} of the {Mansion}, footsore, through a muddy *footprint field*, because he has dropped the Ring and must **turn over** every clod. *feathers* fly up as a furious goose objects to being disturbed. Loyal Sam helps him **turn over** the goose as well, and there is the Ring, looped around its foot, looking pleased with itself.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, cape steaming, in a *heatwave* so **violent** that it melts the taps. Towels whip themselves against the walls and the mirrors rattle. He reaches into his utility belt for a gadget, and a **violent** gust blows him straight out of the window, growling, until his grappling hook hauls him back.

{Sailor Moon} raises her moon wand in {Front} of the {Funfair}, speechifying about justice, and by accident sparkles up a *tree*. Then comes a second *tree*, and a third *tree*, and soon the carousel is lost in a **forest**. She stumbles about crying loudly, clumsy as ever, while Luna the talking cat leads her out of the **forest** by one pigtail.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Basement} of the {Spa} and, baffled by civilisation, tries to build the only tall thing he has heard of: his apes pile up *soil*, layer on layer, each one capped with *thatch*. It becomes a wobbly **pagoda**. He gives his jungle yell from the top of the **pagoda**, and the chimpanzees queue up for massages.

{Mario} creeps into the {Bathroom} of the {Fort}, black with *soot* from a warp pipe, and for once must stay **silent**, because a huge *dog* sleeps on the mat. He tiptoes, moustache quivering, without one 'Wahoo!' Then a block floats past at head height, he head-butts it by habit, and ding! So much for **silent**: the dog wakes, and he runs.

{Walter White} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Fort}, a proud chemistry teacher, showing his class a crystal *cottage* he grew in a beaker. A *helping hand* reaches out to **grasp** it, and it crumbles at one touch. 'Precise tongs,' he says, adjusting his glasses. They **grasp** the tongs, and only then do they **grasp** the science.

{Shrek} just wants a quiet soak in the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, but Donkey bursts in with a costume **drama**: a knight gripping a *halberd* in his *right hand*, gasping out his lines. The ogre roars until the tiles shake. Everyone applauds, taking it for part of the **drama**, and he has to bow, onion in hand.

{Yoshi} creeps down into the {Basement} of the {Inn} and curls up behind a painted *hillside* to stay **hidden**, a *racing heart* thumping so loudly that the jars rattle. He lays a dozen eggs in a heap around himself and tucks in his nose. Now he is perfectly **hidden** among them, one more egg, except for a long green tail.

{Sherlock} stalks {Inside} the {Pool} past a *roast* sizzling on glowing *embers*, his magnifying glass fixed on one crumb of peach in the crackling. 'Elementary, Watson: it fell from a tree three hours ago, perfectly **ripe**.' He squeezes the nearest peach, which sprays his deerstalker, and he smugly pronounces it **ripe**.

{Gandalf} finds a dry old *bone* in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and taps it with his staff. With one cranky spell the **bone** rises, dances and knocks on the pipes, and it summons a second **bone** to join in, with fireworks. 'You shall not pass!' he barks at a dog leaping for it, and the dog, impressed, sits down and waits for its supper.

{Frodo} plods into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} after a very long walk, only to **visit** Sam's cousin. A *small speech bubble* pops up asking why he came; he has crossed a *square*, two mountains and a marsh on bare hairy feet. He slips on the Ring by mistake, the cousin lays a plate for nobody, and next time he will **visit** by post.

{Robocop} clanks into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse}, stiff and heavy, and his visor flashes a warning: battery **weak**. One steel arm droops. 'Directive three,' he reads in a slowing voice, 'arrest that tap.' He cannot close the cuffs, his knees fold, and in a **weak** little voice he apologises politely as he sits down, gently, in the sink.

{Mario} bursts out of a warp pipe {Inside} the {Jungle} and head-butts a block, and out flies a *blindfold*, flapping like a bat to **cover** his eyes. He stomps blindly about, 'Wahoo!', and one stomp shakes down a mushroom. He grows huge, and now he needs whole trees to **cover** his moustache.

{Gandalf} leans on his staff in {Front} of the {Hut} and begins a long and ancient **song**, which of course is a spell. His *elder brother*, an even crankier wizard, joins in on the pipe. A vast magical *yawn* rolls over the valley, and by the ninth verse of the **song** every sheep has fallen asleep standing up.

{Darth Vader} marches into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, breathing loudly, and finds a little **shop** set up in a garden *shed* and run by a *fortune teller*. She tells him he will buy a towel. He lifts the till with the Force and booms his disapproval at the prices, then, as foreseen, leaves the **shop** with a towel and a receipt.

{Gandalf} lights his staff in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *ghost* is rattling all the chairs. 'You shall not pass!' he bellows, and the **ghost** floats straight through him. Cranky, he tries fireworks, and the **ghost** applauds, then politely takes a number and sits down to wait its turn, while he lights his pipe in defeat.

{Robocop} clanks into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} and politely arrests a *cart* stuffed with swan down, and his steel fingers sink right in. His targeting display reads **soft**. A long *yawn* creaks from his visor as the feathers wrap round his armour, and he lies back on the **soft** heap, reading a pillow its rights.

{Darth Vader} looms in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} and with the Force draws a heavy book from behind the *curtains*. It is the **canon**, the great rulebook every Sith must know by heart. Breathing loudly, he booms a *song* from it as the pages turn themselves, and anyone who misquotes the **canon** gets his deepest disapproval.

{Yoshi} wakes in the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} with a *yawn* so huge that a painted *valley* on the wall seems to slide into it. A great **desire** seizes him to eat everything: the soap, the hand dryer, the mop. Tongue out, gulp, gulp, but each egg he lays only fills him with fresh **desire**, and he eyes the door hungrily. 'Yoshi!'

{Sailor Moon} sparkles through her transformation in the {Bathroom} of the {Spa}, trips on a mat of *grass* and lands at the feet of a calm **Bodhisattva** sitting on a folded towel. She gives her full speech about justice and bursts into loud tears. The **Bodhisattva** only smiles and pats her pigtail, and Luna the talking cat bows low.

{Homer} naps by a *campfire* in the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}, doughnut on his chest, when a *standing person* comes up offering marshmallows. 'Mmm,' he says, and just like that he has a **companion**. His dim scheme to share only half backfires when the doughnut rolls into the fire. 'D'oh!' Still, a **companion** laughs and hands you the burnt bit.

{Zorro} gallops up the *road* in {Front} of the {Tower} on his black horse and slashes a Z through a rope to swing dashingly up. It snaps, and down he drops into a *trough* of cold muddy water. His mask slips, his cape sags and even Zorro must **suffer**, but only he could **suffer** a wet hat with such style.

{Pikachu} scampers {Inside} the {Mansion} and finds a **plate** the size of a pond, with a tiny *boat* floating on gravy in the middle of the *dish*. 'Pika!' he squeaks, climbing aboard after the peppers. His cheeks spark, a Thunderbolt cracks the **plate** clean down the centre, and the boat sinks while he sits on the dry half, munching.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa}, grappling hook ready, as a *python* coils around somebody's *father* in a robe. The kids shout '**Dad**!' A batarang ties the snake in a neat bow, and gruffly he tells them, 'Your **dad** is safe.' The python, unwrapped, slithers off wearing the bow, and the man tells a terrible joke.
